verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs standard Docker images as VMs globally (fly-io-docs-32, fly-io-docs-14), and its database is standard PostgreSQL (fly-io-docs-19). This implies application code targets ordinary Linux/container runtimes rather than a proprietary edge runtime or storage API. However, the evidence never states portability across other edge platforms. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of standards-based runtime APIs, evidence that the same code runs unmodified on other edge platforms, and independent corroboration of avoiding lock-in.
